title: Set default options for maintenance stations
goal: Add labels and options to select, and use selected to specify the items selected when opening for the first time.
summary: maintenance corner has three work stations. Use the drop-down box to collect the workstations selected when making an appointment. When the page opens, the electronic station will be displayed first.
tasks: Change "maintenance station" to label, and use for="bench" to associate the drop-down box.

Create a select with both id and name set to bench. Add options with the values wood, electronics, and bike. Use the labels "woodworking bench", "electronic station", and "bicycle platform" respectively.
Set selected for the electronic station. After opening the preview, confirm that the drop-down box displays the electronic station by default.

example.code:
<label for="pickup-point">collection location</label>
<select id="pickup-point" name="pickup-point">
  <option value="north">North Gate</option>
  <option value="hall" selected>lobby</option>
</select>
example.note: option is displayed in the menu, and the value is used for submission. selected is written on the option to be selected by default.

hint: Write selected to the option of the electronic station. When there are options available in a single-select drop-down box, browsers usually select the first item by default.
